blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The northeasterly wind flow and the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) will continue to bring rain to parts of the country, while a tropical depression being monitored outside the Philippine area of responsibility is not expected to affect the country, according to the state weather bureau. In the 5 a.m. weather forecast of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration, weather specialist Chenel Dominguez said that the northeasterly wind flow will affect Northern Luzon while the ITCZ will prevail over Visayas and Mindanao.
